perspective.label: How I see it
perspective.title: I don't build screens. I build answers.
perspective.copyOne: I want to understand what people need, what makes an idea viable and which technology makes sense to move it forward. Code comes after those questions.
perspective.copyTwo: I work well where business, experience and development meet. That is where an abstract idea starts becoming something that works.
perspective.quote: My job is to shorten the distance between “I have an idea” and “it is already working”.

understand.title: Understand
understand.copy: I listen, organise the context and identify the problem that is truly worth solving.

decide.title: Decide
decide.copy: I connect product, people and business to choose a clear and realistic path.

build.title: Build
build.copy: I design, develop, test and finish. The idea becomes something people can use.

human.label: Behind the work
human.title: Curiosity, discipline and feet on the ground.
human.copyOne: My journey did not begin or end with code. I come from systems, sport, sales and entrepreneurship. That mix helps me speak with very different people and see the whole product.
human.copyTwo: I get involved, ask questions and say what I think. I look for honest working relationships and projects that bring something real to the person on the other side.
